name: Nagaokakyō (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nagaokakyō city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric arcs crossed by a horizontal bar.
history: Municipal flag of Nagaokakyō, a city in Kyoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1959.

features.role: Nagaokakyō city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric arcs crossed by a horizontal bar
